issues.explanation: Extra brace block after access() leaves a bare { return hasMany(Ticket) } with no function signature, a PHP parse error.
Trait imported from Illuminate\Contracts\Auth\HandlesAuthorization which does not exist; correct trait is Illuminate\Auth\Access\HandlesAuthorization, so the policy fatals on load.
CreateQueue performs no authorization check, so any user can create queues instead of owner/admin only.
UpdateQueue performs no authorization check, so any user can rename or deactivate queues.
No migration creates the required queue_access table with FKs, JSON permissions, timestamps and unique index.
SetQueueAccess re-implements manager check with a direct EntityMembership query instead of authorizing through QueuePolicy via Gate.
SetQueueAccess throws App\Exceptions\AuthorizationException instead of the required Illuminate\Auth\Access\AuthorizationException.
CallNextTicket inserts authorization after mutating $winner in memory and shows only one site, so coverage of every call mode and lock plus active-check ordering cannot be verified.
CHANGELOG replaces the whole Keep-a-Changelog file with six lines instead of appending to the Unreleased Added section.
business-rules.md and database-schema.md replace full domain docs and ER diagram with short stubs instead of updating them in place.
Diff contains no Pest/PHPUnit tests for queue lifecycle, access grants, policy abilities, or unauthorized paths.
authorizeCall wraps Gate::authorize in an if-not check that never fails on success and leaves $entityId fetched but unused, obscuring the required inactive then authorize then waiting-only ordering.
Duplicate UserRole import plus unused Model import left in the file.
Permission validation uses Arr::pluck on enum cases which is fragile for backed enums and should use explicit tryFrom or value comparison.
Empty-after-slugify slugs are not rejected and every QueryException is mapped to a slug-taken ValidationException without checking the unique index.
Factory always creates a fresh entity, membership and queue in definition even when the caller supplies overrides.

conventions.evidence: Uses app/Actions/* and audit channel (SetQueueAccess.php:189,198) and #[Fillable] correctly, but auth bypasses policies, no generated migration, CHANGELOG.md:1-53 and docs/* wiped instead of synced

readability.evidence: Queue.php:304-306 parse error; SetQueueAccess.php:142-149 duplicate/unused imports; Ticket.php:359 dead $entityId; docs replaced with stubs

requirements.evidence: Queue.php:304-306 syntax error; QueuePolicy.php:406 wrong HandlesAuthorization namespace; CreateQueue.php:94 and UpdateQueue.php:224 no authorization; no queue_access migration in diff

scope.evidence: CHANGELOG.md:1-53 deletes all history; docs/business-rules.md:1-8 and docs/database-schema.md:1-13 delete ER diagram and invariants; no unrelated features but large destructive edits beyond task

security.evidence: CreateQueue.php:94 and UpdateQueue.php:224 allow unauthorized writes; SetQueueAccess.php:168 uses wrong AuthorizationException class; QueuePolicy.php:406 fatal import breaks enforcement

simplicity.evidence: Actions/policy/factory are direct with no speculative layers, but isManager duplicated in policy and SetQueueAccess, plus dead $entityId and overly broad QueryException catch

tests.evidence: No test files in change.diff; no happy-path, validation, unauthorized-call or tamper tests despite conventions requiring them

review.summary: Adds queue lifecycle actions, queue_access model/factory/policy and call-path checks, but Queue.php has a parse error, QueuePolicy imports a non-existent trait, and CreateQueue/UpdateQueue have no authorization; with no migration, no tests, and destructive CHANGELOG/docs rewrites, the change must be rejected.
